name: Gizmo Weft

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Sticky Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.

perks.name: Spike Grenades
perks.desc:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Air Trigger
perks.desc: Increased ammo generation. When airborne, accuracy and reload speed are increased but target acquisition is decreased.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.desc: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Reverberation
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for a short duration.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.desc: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Contending Cascade
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving an impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained damage against bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly as part of a boss damage weapon rotation. Gizmo Weft is a micro-missile frame GL which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic as they've been power crept by other special weapons, but are still useful for movement. The stats are good by comparison with its one other peer - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/4069880346 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Looks for a barrel perk that helps Handling and Velocity. Try not to hurt the Blast Radius, as that affects the width and height of the wave. For the magazine perk either Implosion Rounds or Spike Grenades will boost damage a little or alternatively High-Velocity Rounds is still decent. For a sustained boss damage roll as part of a weapon rotation, Envious Arsenal in the first trait perk column refills the magazine from reserves on dealing damage with both of your other weapons. For damage, Bait and Switch boosts damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s when enhanced) on the same condition to proc. Other good options are Elemental Honing which grants an escalating stack of damage up to ×1.35 for 20s (23s enhanced) for each elemental damage type inflicted, which can be refreshed with a new damage type until you've run through all 5, Aggregate Charge to provide a stack for each different elemental debuff up to ×3 stacks to boost damage by up to ×1.3 (×1.33 enhanced), with each stack lasting as long as the debuff is active, or Bipod to trade having two rockets in the chamber for burst damage for -20 to Blast Radius and Reload Speed (-15 to Reload Speed enhanced) and a reduction by ×0.75 damage. For the Origin Trait, you earn a stack of Contending Cascade after kills within 4s from any source - achieving 15 stacks (12 enhanced) grants Crowning Cascade to boost Handling and Reload Speed, and an elemental explosion on kills until you die. If you're facing vehicles and constructs in an activity, there's also Häkke Breach Armaments for passive boosts to damage. If you're interested, "Gizmo" is a gadget that you can't remember the name of and "Weft" is a term in weaving for the crosswise threads that are passed over and under warp threads to make cloth, so maybe a reference to Strand? Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for burst damage against Banes, Elites, Champions and Minibosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. For a burst damage roll which can also be useful in short boss DPS windows, Slideshot refills the mag and boosts Velocity and Stability by +20 each (+22 when enhanced) when you slide, or Air Trigger improves Ammo Generation by +20 (+30 enhanced), and while you're in the air, Reload Speed by +30 (+35 enhanced) with a ×0.8 animation multiplier. If you're facing vehicles and constructs in an activity, there's also Häkke Breach Armaments for passive boosts to damage. The recommendations are going to be for vertical movement tech. And then separately for DPS in case it winds up being worth it for swap." Recommended MW: Handling, Reload.
